title_english: Ahom-Buranji: Chronicle of Khamjang and the Nora Ancestral Clans (Barua 1930)
informant: Rai Sahib Golap Chandra Barua & Khalaighogra Deodhai Pandits
description: Historical chronicle extracted and adapted from Rai Sahib Golap Chandra Barua's landmark 1930 bilingual work 'Ahom-Buranji: From the Earliest Time to the End of Ahom Rule' (Baptist Mission Press, Calcutta), recording Chau Lung Sukapha's arrival in the country of Khamjang, the march of the Thomung and Kalangshu (Chowlik) clans, and diplomatic relations with the Nora Raja.

sentences.free_translation_en: The great prince Chau Lung Sukapha marched across the mountains and arrived in the ancestral country of Khamjang.
sentences.free_translation_as: চৌলুং চুকাফা পাতকাইৰ গিৰিপথেৰে নামি আহি পোনপ্ৰথমে প্ৰাচীন খামজাং দেশত উপস্থিত হ'ল।
sentences.speaker: Rai Sahib Golap Chandra Barua / Deodhai Manuscript
sentences.location: Sibsagar, Assam (1930 Baptist Mission Press edition)
sentences.notes: Authentic bilingual historical passage from Ahom-Buranji (1930, pp. 44-48, 236-242) documenting Khamjang and the Nora lineage.

sentences.free_translation_en: The noble Thomung family and the Kalangshu (Chowlik) lineages accompanied the prince from Khamjang.
sentences.free_translation_as: খামজাং দেশৰ পৰা থৌমুং ফৈদ আৰু কলংশু (চৌলিক) বংশধৰসকলে ৰাজকুমাৰৰ লগত যাত্ৰা আৰম্ভ কৰিলে।
sentences.speaker: Rai Sahib Golap Chandra Barua / Deodhai Manuscript
sentences.location: Sibsagar, Assam (1930 Baptist Mission Press edition)
sentences.notes: Authentic bilingual historical passage from Ahom-Buranji (1930, pp. 44-48, 236-242) documenting Khamjang and the Nora lineage.

sentences.free_translation_en: King Sukapha appointed Lord Kangkhrumung as the ruler to govern the homeland of Khamjang.
sentences.free_translation_as: স্বৰ্গদেউ চুকাফাই কাংক্ৰুমুংক খামজাং দেশৰ অধিকাৰী পাতি তাত শাসন চলাবলৈ নিৰ্দেশ দিলে।
sentences.speaker: Rai Sahib Golap Chandra Barua / Deodhai Manuscript
sentences.location: Sibsagar, Assam (1930 Baptist Mission Press edition)
sentences.notes: Authentic bilingual historical passage from Ahom-Buranji (1930, pp. 44-48, 236-242) documenting Khamjang and the Nora lineage.

sentences.assamese_script: চাৱ³ লুঙ¹ সু⁵ কা³ ফা³ খা³ অ¹ পাত্‌⁴ কাই¹
sentences.free_translation_en: The royal host crossed over the high Patkai range and entered the valley of the Buridihing.
sentences.free_translation_as: তাৰ পিছত চৌলুং চুকাফাই সুবিশাল সৈন্যদল লৈ পাতকাই পাৰ হৈ বুঢ়ীদিহিং উপত্যকাত প্ৰৱেশ কৰিলে।
sentences.speaker: Rai Sahib Golap Chandra Barua / Deodhai Manuscript
sentences.location: Sibsagar, Assam (1930 Baptist Mission Press edition)
sentences.notes: Authentic bilingual historical passage from Ahom-Buranji (1930, pp. 44-48, 236-242) documenting Khamjang and the Nora lineage.

sentences.assamese_script: খোন¹ ন¹ পেন¹ ফি⁵ নোঙ⁴ কাপ্‌⁴ চাৱ³ ফা⁴ অ¹ হোম¹
sentences.free_translation_en: The Nora (Khamyang) people and the Ahoms lived in unbroken fraternal kinship as elder and younger brothers.
sentences.free_translation_as: নোৰা (খাময়াং) আৰু আহোম ৰাজবংশৰ লোকসকলে ককাই-ভাইৰ দৰে চিৰকাল ভাতৃত্বৰ বান্ধোনেৰে বান্ধ খাই আছিল।
sentences.speaker: Rai Sahib Golap Chandra Barua / Deodhai Manuscript
sentences.location: Sibsagar, Assam (1930 Baptist Mission Press edition)
sentences.notes: Authentic bilingual historical passage from Ahom-Buranji (1930, pp. 44-48, 236-242) documenting Khamjang and the Nora lineage.

sentences.free_translation_en: King Shudangpha sent respectful royal greetings, gifts, and treaties of peace to the Nora Raja.
sentences.free_translation_as: আহোম স্বৰ্গদেউ ছুদাংফাই নোৰা ৰজালৈ উপহাৰ আৰু মৈত্ৰীৰ চৰ্ত সম্বলিত প্ৰীতিৰ পত্ৰ প্ৰেৰণ কৰিলে।
sentences.speaker: Rai Sahib Golap Chandra Barua / Deodhai Manuscript
sentences.location: Sibsagar, Assam (1930 Baptist Mission Press edition)
sentences.notes: Authentic bilingual historical passage from Ahom-Buranji (1930, pp. 44-48, 236-242) documenting Khamjang and the Nora lineage.

sentences.free_translation_en: The Nora Raja sent celestial blessings, skilled artisans, and astrologers back to the Ahom capital.
sentences.free_translation_as: নোৰা ৰজাইও গড়গাঁৱৰ ৰাজদৰবাৰলৈ তाई জ্যোতিষী, লিপিকাৰ আৰু শিল্পী পঠিয়াই বন্ধুত্ব অক্ষুণ্ণ ৰাখিলে।
sentences.speaker: Rai Sahib Golap Chandra Barua / Deodhai Manuscript
sentences.location: Sibsagar, Assam (1930 Baptist Mission Press edition)
sentences.notes: Authentic bilingual historical passage from Ahom-Buranji (1930, pp. 44-48, 236-242) documenting Khamjang and the Nora lineage.

sentences.free_translation_en: Thus the ancient Ahom-Buranji chronicles preserve the glory of Khamjang and the Nora clans forever.
